parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular in shape, and attached to the cabinet frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a movable cover to enclose and protect the contents of the cabinet, providing access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right cabinet door made of MDF, similar to the left door, and attached to the cabinet frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It provides closure and access to the right compartment of the cabinet, maintaining the aesthetic symmetry of the furniture.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, forming the outer box that supports the doors and shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity, supports the doors and shelves, and defines the overall shape of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is an internal horizontal shelf made of particle board, fitted inside the cabinet frame.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a flat surface for storing or organizing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.
